title: sao SEC2: feed regeneration not cached server-side
description:
Feed XML is regenerated on every request (generate_rss/generate_atom called per request). HTTP Cache-Control headers hint at client/CDN caching, but no server-side caching layer.

For high-volume groups, this could be inefficient. However, limit defaults to 100 articles, so XML size is bounded ~50-100KB per feed.

Acceptable for v1. Consider memoization with LRU eviction in future versions if metrics show this as hot path.
